NURS 112.description: Introduction to the profession of nursing. Provides the framework for the development and evolution of nursing practice.
NURS 112.subject: NURS
NURS 112.title: Introduction to Nursing as a Profession

NURS 201.description: A comprehensive introduction to the field of human genetics designed to raise nursing students’ awareness of the role of genetics in all areas of medical care. A clinical approach and emphasis.
NURS 201.subject: NURS
NURS 201.title: Introduction to Human Genetics for Health Care Professionals

NURS 208.description: An integration of nursing, computer and information sciences for the support of nursing practice. Focusing on effective utilization of technology and its application to nursing practice.
NURS 208.subject: NURS
NURS 208.title: Introduction to Nursing Informatics

NURS 210.description: Examination of communication theory and development of communication skills. Focuses on non-directive and directive interviewing techniques with dyads, small groups, and families.
NURS 210.subject: NURS
NURS 210.title: Facilitative Communication

NURS 216.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: CHEM 102; BIOL 243 and BIOL 244 or EXSC 224 and accompanying labs.
NURS 216.subject: NURS
NURS 216.title: Biophysical Pathology

NURS 220.description: Principles of normal and therapeutic nutrition, and the role of the nurse in nutritional care.
NURS 220.subject: NURS
NURS 220.title: Clinical Nutrition

NURS 226.description: Diverse health care belief systems and how they influence human responses to health and illness. Focus on African-American and other cultural groups.
NURS 226.subject: NURS
NURS 226.title: Socio-Cultural Variations in Health and Illness

NURS 250.description: Nursing as a science; selected concepts of self-care and communication within the context of nursing science. Transition course for registered nurse students only. Credit received for NURS 110 and NURS 210 upon completion.
NURS 250.subject: NURS
NURS 250.title: Nursing Science in Professional Practice

NURS 309.description: Cognitive skills, psychomotor skills and technologies necessary to perform health assessment.
NURS 309.subject: NURS
NURS 309.title: Nursing Health Assessment

NURS 311.description: Cognitive skills, psychomotor skills, and technologies necessary to perform health assessment. Laboratory required.
NURS 311.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 220.
NURS 311.subject: NURS
NURS 311.title: Introduction to Health Assessment

NURS 312.description: Cognitive, affective, and psychomotor skills and technologies necessary to nursing intervention. Practicum required.
NURS 312.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 220.
NURS 312.subject: NURS
NURS 312.title: Foundations of Nursing Practice

NURS 313.description: Nursing care focusing on health promotion, restoration, and support of older adults. Restricted to upper division nursing students.
NURS 313.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Generic BSN Students: C or better in NURS 220; RN-BSN Students: C or better in NURS 250.
NURS 313.subject: NURS
NURS 313.title: Nursing Care of the Older Adult

NURS 314.description: The process of making clinical judgments.
NURS 314.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 220.
NURS 314.subject: NURS
NURS 314.title: Clinical Reasoning in Nursing Practice

NURS 318.description: Concepts of disease processes in the human body and related pharmacologic interventions. Focus on nursing assessments and interventions.
NURS 318.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 250.
NURS 318.subject: NURS
NURS 318.title: Application of Pathophysiology and Pharmacology in Nursing

NURS 324.description: Pharmacology with an emphasis on clinical applications within the context of the nursing process and prioritization of needs.
NURS 324.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 220.
NURS 324.subject: NURS
NURS 324.title: Chemical Therapeutics

NURS 327.description: Perioperative care of clients with common, recurring nursing problems requiring surgical intervention. Perioperative practicum required.
NURS 327.subject: NURS
NURS 327.title: Perioperative Nursing

NURS 397.description: Review and revalidation of cognitive, psychomotor, and technological skills necessary to perform health assessment and selected clinical functions. On-campus laboratory time required.
NURS 397.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 397.subject: NURS
NURS 397.title: Essential Clinical Skills Validation

NURS 398.description: Topics of special interest in nursing. Individual topics to be announced in schedule by title.
NURS 398.subject: NURS
NURS 398.title: Selected Topics

NURS 399.description: Number of credits to be contracted with instructor at the beginning of the course. Contract approved by instructor, advisor and department head is required for undergraduate students.
NURS 399.subject: NURS
NURS 399.title: Independent Study

NURS 400.description: Introduction to the language and process of research and the use of best practices to guide nursing practice.
NURS 400.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 314 for Generic BSN students; C or better in NURS 250 for RN-BSN students.
NURS 400.subject: NURS
NURS 400.title: Evidence-based Nursing Practice

NURS 406.description: Introduction to nursing of the critically ill adult. Application in selected clinical settings.
NURS 406.subject: NURS
NURS 406.title: Critical Care Nursing of Adults

NURS 411.description: Nursing care of clients experiencing psychiatric/mental health problems, with focus on promotion, restoration, and support. Practicum required.
NURS 411.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 412, NURS 413, and NURS 426.
NURS 411.subject: NURS
NURS 411.title: Psychiatric/Mental Health Nursing

NURS 412.description: Nursing care of acutely ill adults in a variety of settings. Practicum required.
NURS 412.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 412.subject: NURS
NURS 412.title: Acute Care Nursing of Adults I

NURS 413.description: Using principles of communication in nursing to engage in peer-to-peer interactions to enhance cognitive skills, psychomotor skills, and technologies necessary to reinforce foundational nursing skills, Lab required.
NURS 413.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 413.subject: NURS
NURS 413.title: Intradisciplinary Communication and Skills Development

NURS 420.description: Examination of emerging health-related issues and their relevance to professional nursing practice.
NURS 420.subject: NURS
NURS 420.title: Emerging Issues in Health Care

NURS 422.description: Nursing care of acutely ill adults in a variety of settings. Practicum required.
NURS 422.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 412, NURS 413, and NURS 426 .
NURS 422.subject: NURS
NURS 422.title: Acute Care Nursing of Adults II

NURS 424.description: Nursing care of childbearing women and their neonates and families. Focus on uncomplicated pregnancy and birthing processes. Practicum required.
NURS 424.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 424.subject: NURS
NURS 424.title: Maternal/Newborn Nursing

NURS 425.description: Nursing care of families throughout their childrearing years, focusing on health promotion, restoration, and support of their children. Practicum required.
NURS 425.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 425.subject: NURS
NURS 425.title: Nursing of Children and Families

NURS 426.description: Nursing care of children and childbearing families focusing on developmental, biological, and psychosocial health and illness needs. Clinical required.
NURS 426.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 311, NURS 312, NURS 313, NURS 314, and NURS 324.
NURS 426.subject: NURS
NURS 426.title: Concepts of Pediatric and Reproductive Health

NURS 427.description: Using principles of communication and leadership to foster peer-to-peer interactions to enhance cognitive skills, psychomotor skills, and technologies necessary to reinforce foundational nursing skills. Lab required.
NURS 427.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 412, NURS 413, and NURS 426.
NURS 427.subject: NURS
NURS 427.title: Intradisciplinary Coordination and Skills Management

NURS 428.description: Concepts and principles of leadership, management, policy, and politics in delivering patient care within health care systems and the implications related to nursing practice. Relationships between policies and politics in the health field and the impact on patient care and access to healthcare.
NURS 428.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Generic BSN students: C or better in NURS 411, NURS 422, NURS 427, and NURS 431; RN-BSN students: C or better in NURS 250 .
NURS 428.subject: NURS
NURS 428.title: Nursing Leadership and Management

NURS 431.description: Concepts and principles of aggregate and community health.
NURS 431.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Generic BSN Students: C or better for NURS 412, NURS 413, and NURS 426.
NURS 431.subject: NURS
NURS 431.title: Population Health Nursing

NURS 434.description: Community-based application and synthesis of professional nursing roles and responsibilities with selected populations determined to be at risk for a variety of health-related problems.
NURS 434.subject: NURS
NURS 434.title: Community-Based Clinical Practicum for RNs

NURS 435.description: Clinical experiences in managing patient care and leading the healthcare team in a variety of agencies. Practicum required.
NURS 435.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in NURS 411, NURS 422, NURS 427, and NURS 431.
NURS 435.subject: NURS
NURS 435.title: Senior Nursing Capstone Practicum

NURS 491.description: Comprehensive assessment and analysis of a community and its environment within the framework of community health nursing. Practicum only.
NURS 491.subject: NURS
NURS 491.title: Community and Environmental Assessment

NURS 502.description: Provides the opportunity for students to study healthcare systems, health policy, and cultural values surrounding health care in countries outside the USA.
NURS 502.subject: NURS
NURS 502.title: International Issues in Health Care and Policy

NURS 504.description: Principles of emergency preparedness with implications for health care at the local, regional, national, and global levels.
NURS 504.subject: NURS
NURS 504.title: Emergency Preparedness: Implications for Health Care Professionals

NURS 505.description: Principles and policies for clinical practice with Limited English Proficient patients.
NURS 505.subject: NURS
NURS 505.title: Caring for Limited English Proficient Patients

NURS 506.description: Experiential field study to examine international nursing in another country. Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of courses by title. May be repeated for credit.
NURS 506.subject: NURS
NURS 506.title: Special Topics in International Nursing

NURS 534.description: Students live and practice in a rural, interdisciplinary environment and participate in an organized community-based health care activity. Contract approved by instructor and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
NURS 534.subject: NURS
NURS 534.title: The Rural Interdisciplinary Practicum

NURS 541.description: An exploration of women’s health and health care concerns from multiple perspectives.
NURS 541.subject: NURS
NURS 541.title: Issues in Women's Health

NURS 553.description: Organizing, developing, implementing, and evaluating the in-service education program.
NURS 553.subject: NURS
NURS 553.title: In-Service Education

NURS 571.description: Topics vary by title, consent of instructor.
NURS 571.subject: NURS
NURS 571.title: Special Topics

NURS 590.description: Provides the opportunity for students to study education, healthcare systems, and cultural values surrounding health care in countries outside the U.S.A.
NURS 590.subject: NURS
NURS 590.title: Special Topics in International Nursing and Healthcare

NURS 700.description: Concept development, model and theoretical framework interpretation, and theoretical formulations in nursing. Critical analysis of current theories of nursing, related nursing research, and selected theories from natural, behavioral, and applied health sciences.
NURS 700.subject: NURS
NURS 700.title: Theoretical and Conceptual Foundation for Nursing

NURS 701.description: Introduction to the profession of nursing. Provides the framework for the development of nursing practice through the critical analysis of current nursing and systems theories.
NURS 701.subject: NURS
NURS 701.title: Introduction to Nursing Practice and Theory

NURS 702.description: Pharmacologic management of acute and chronic health problems of pediatric, adult and gerontological patients across the healthcare delivery continuum.
NURS 702.subject: NURS
NURS 702.title: Pharmacologic Mgmt in Pediatric, Adult, Gerontological Patients Across Hlthcare Delivery Continuum

NURS 703.description: Intensive engagement in self-assessment of leadership ability and development of proven successful leadership strategies relevant to practice, academia and policy development in complex interdisciplinary healthcare systems. Restricted to acceptance into the Amy C. Cockcroft Nursing Leadership Development program.
NURS 703.subject: NURS
NURS 703.title: Executive Leadership Development Cockcroft

NURS 704.description: Advanced theory and practice in critical thinking, physical assessment, diagnostic reasoning for clients across the life span to identify pathologic variations and initiate appropriate interventions. Didactic, lab, and field study.
NURS 704.subject: NURS
NURS 704.title: Advanced Health Assessment and Diagnostic Reasoning

NURS 707.description: Advanced concepts of pathophysiological functioning with application to advanced nursing practice in selected specialty areas.
NURS 707.subject: NURS
NURS 707.title: Advanced Pathophysiology for Nurses

NURS 709.description: Pathophysiological processes and application for nursing practice.
NURS 709.subject: NURS
NURS 709.title: Pathophysiological Concepts for Nursing Practice

NURS 710.description: Explores the integrated roles of the nurse educator, including teaching, scholarship, service, and practice.
NURS 710.subject: NURS
NURS 710.title: Role of the Nurse Educator

NURS 711.description: Phamacotherapies treatments and application for nursing practice.
NURS 711.subject: NURS
NURS 711.title: Pharmacotherapies for Nursing Practice

NURS 712.description: Health assessment processes and application for nursing practice.
NURS 712.subject: NURS
NURS 712.title: Health Assessment for Nursing Practice

NURS 713.description: Introduction to cognitive, affective, and psychomotor skills and technology needed for nursing interventions.
NURS 713.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 709, NURS 711, and NURS 712.
NURS 713.subject: NURS
NURS 713.title: Nursing Practice Fundamentals

NURS 714.description: Nursing interventions focusing on health promotion, restoration, and support to childbearing families. Field study required.
NURS 714.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 709, NURS 711, NURS 712 and NURS 713.
NURS 714.subject: NURS
NURS 714.title: Maternal/Newborn Nursing Practice

NURS 715.description: Nursing care of families with children, focusing on support for child growth and development, health promotion and health restoration. Field study required.
NURS 715.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 709, NURS 711, NURS 712 and NURS 713.
NURS 715.subject: NURS
NURS 715.title: Pediatric Nursing Practice

NURS 716.description: Nursing care of childbearing families, focusing on support for childbearing individuals, child growth and development, health promotion and health restoration. Field study required.
NURS 716.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 709, NURS 711, and NURS 712.
NURS 716.subject: NURS
NURS 716.title: Maternal, Newborn, and Pediatric Nursing

NURS 717.description: Application of basic statistical principles and procedures to address common nursing practice issues and guide nursing practice and management.
NURS 717.subject: NURS
NURS 717.title: Application of Basic Statistics for Nursing Practice Service Management

NURS 718.description: Analysis of diagnostic and laboratory findings for clinical decision-making in advanced practice nursing. Course incorporates selected medical and nursing diagnostic and therapeutic modalities.
NURS 718.subject: NURS
NURS 718.title: Diagnostic Interpretation and Therapeutic Modalities

NURS 719.description: Introduction to advanced nursing practice. Provides the framework for the transition to advance practice through the critical analysis of current advanced nursing practice within a complex health care environment.
NURS 719.subject: NURS
NURS 719.title: Transition to Advanced Nursing Practice

NURS 720.description: Application of concepts and principles of epidemiology, genetics/genomics, health informatics, and population health assessment to support clinical decision-making skills within different practice environments and health policy development.
NURS 720.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 717 or NURS 789.
NURS 720.subject: NURS
NURS 720.title: Clinical Application of Population Analysis

NURS 721.description: Nursing care focusing on health promotion, restoration and support of older adults.
NURS 721.subject: NURS
NURS 721.title: Gerontological Nursing Care

NURS 723.description: Nursing Care of the patient with Chronic Health Problems.
NURS 723.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 713 and NURS 716.
NURS 723.subject: NURS
NURS 723.title: Medical Surgical Nursing Practice I

NURS 724.description: Introduction to the teaching-learning environment in nursing, including educational theories, strategies, assessment, and facilitation of learning and learner development and socialization.
NURS 724.subject: NURS
NURS 724.title: Education in Nursing

NURS 725.description: The course introduces principles of curriculum development, design, implementation and evaluation. Evaluation measures explore internal and external constituents, including meeting that reflect contemporary health care trends and educational expectations, and prepare graduates to function effectively in the health measurement techniques are examined.
NURS 725.subject: NURS
NURS 725.title: Education: Curriculum and Evaluation

NURS 726.description: Nursing care of the patient with acute health issues.
NURS 726.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 723 and NURS 729.
NURS 726.subject: NURS
NURS 726.title: Medical Surgical Nursing Practice II

NURS 727.description: Precepted clinical immersion experience in the academic nurse educator’s role.
NURS 727.subject: NURS
NURS 727.title: Teaching Practicum in Nursing

NURS 728.description: Apply community and public health principles across a variety of health care settings, special populations, and scenarios to solve community-level health problems and develop appropriate nursing interventions.
NURS 728.subject: NURS
NURS 728.title: Transition to Nursing Practice with Communities

NURS 729.description: Nursing care of clients experiencing psychiatric/mental health problems, with a focus on health promotion, restoration, and support.
NURS 729.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 713 and NURS 716.
NURS 729.subject: NURS
NURS 729.title: Psychiatric Nursing Practice

NURS 730.description: Trends of the public health workforce capacity and issues impacting the health of individuals and communities.
NURS 730.subject: NURS
NURS 730.title: Population Health Nursing

NURS 733.description: Explores the basic understanding of evidence-based practice and research methods. Clinical judgment, interprofessional perspectives, and patient preferences as applied to practice are included.
NURS 733.subject: NURS
NURS 733.title: Transition to Evidence-Based Nursing Practice Evidence Measures

NURS 734.description: Organizational, systems, and complexity theory analysis with an emphasis on nursing leadership roles, strategic planning, systems thinking and conceptualizing organizations as complex adaptive systems.
NURS 734.subject: NURS
NURS 734.title: Conceptual Basis of Health Systems

NURS 735.description: Concepts and principles of leadership, management, policy, and advocacy within health care systems and the implications related to advanced nursing practice, interprofessional collaboration, and patient outcomes.
NURS 735.subject: NURS
NURS 735.title: Transition to Nursing Leadership, Ethics and Policy

NURS 736.description: Intersections of women’s work and women’s health in diverse social, cultural, economic, geographic, and political contexts.
NURS 736.subject: NURS
NURS 736.title: Women, Work and Health: Global Perspectives

NURS 737.description: This course is designed to introduce students to the Doctor of Nursing Practice degree to include the roles of expert clinician, clinical scholar, policy and patient advocate, and leader in health care.
NURS 737.subject: NURS
NURS 737.title: Foundations for DNP Development

NURS 738.description: Application of the principles of financial management to the systems involved in the delivery of health care.
NURS 738.subject: NURS
NURS 738.title: Financing of Health Care

NURS 739.description: Principles of evidenced-base practices for online/distance-based education and technology in nursing education.
NURS 739.subject: NURS
NURS 739.title: Online Instruction and Technology in Nursing Education

NURS 740.description: Issues, structures, and processes employed in providing a supportive environment for professional nursing practice. Emphasis on development of professional nursing systems models.
NURS 740.subject: NURS
NURS 740.title: Facilitative Processes in Health Care Leadership

NURS 741.description: Methods for supporting nursing systems with resources of health care delivery systems. Focus is on professional and systems relationships.
NURS 741.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 740 or a student who holds an MBA, MHA, or MPH.
NURS 741.subject: NURS
NURS 741.title: Coordinating Processes in Health Care Leadership

NURS 742.description: Strategies for maximizing the potential of nursing services within organizations. Methods for meeting the challenges presented by complex changes occurring in the health care system. Practicum.
NURS 742.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 741.
NURS 742.subject: NURS
NURS 742.title: Integrative Processes in Health Care Leadership

NURS 743.description: Precepted clinical immersion experience in specialty areas with emphasis on the nursing educator’s role in a healthcare setting.
NURS 743.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 707, NURS 702, and NURS 704.
NURS 743.subject: NURS
NURS 743.title: Advanced Nursing Practicum for the Educator

NURS 744.description: Analysis of the normal anatomy physiologic basis for reproduction in humans that serves as the foundation for clinical assessment, decision making, and management for certified nurse midwives.
NURS 744.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 702, NURS 704, and NURS 707.
NURS 744.subject: NURS
NURS 744.title: Anatomy and Physiology for the Certified Nurse-Midwife

NURS 745.description: Issues and trends in ethics, policy and advocacy for nursing practice.
NURS 745.subject: NURS
NURS 745.title: Nursing Ethics, Policy Advocacy

NURS 746.description: Explores the application of informatics and technology in healthcare and other emerging issues in the field.
NURS 746.subject: NURS
NURS 746.title: Informatics, Technology, and Emerging Issues

NURS 747.description: Concepts and principles of leadership roles and the management functions of professional nurses in a contemporary health care environment, interprofessional relationships and quality/safety principles. Students will also utilize evidence-based research to examine clinical questions.
NURS 747.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 726 and NURS 750.
NURS 747.subject: NURS
NURS 747.title: Leadership and Safety for Nursing Practice

NURS 748.description: Strategies for effective care coordination and effective measurement of patient outcomes related to care transitions.
NURS 748.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 726 and NURS 750.
NURS 748.subject: NURS
NURS 748.title: Care Coordination and Outcomes Management

NURS 749.description: Analysis of both historical perspectives and current societal influences with consideration of how each has impacted the development of nurse-midwifery and the midwifery profession.
NURS 749.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 757.
NURS 749.subject: NURS
NURS 749.title: Foundations of Midwifery

NURS 750.description: Focuses on quality/safety in the healthcare setting and includes field study.
NURS 750.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 723 and NURS 729.
NURS 750.subject: NURS
NURS 750.title: Transition to Nursing Practice I

NURS 751.description: Application and synthesizing knowledge and skills learned throughout the nursing program. Students will integrate content from previous courses during class time and clinical experiences.
NURS 751.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 726 and NURS 750.
NURS 751.subject: NURS
NURS 751.title: Transition to Nursing Practice II

NURS 752.description: Management of antepartum and postpartum care using evidence-based practice guidelines, laboratory and diagnostic studies, including the basic understanding of fetal evaluation in determining health promotion needs of the midwifery patient.
NURS 752.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 744, NURS 749.
NURS 752.subject: NURS
NURS 752.title: Nurse-Midwifery Management: Antepartum PostPartum Care

NURS 753.description: Focuses on the management of care during physiologic childbirth and immediate postpartum and the newborn period including the development of clinical judgment and decision making. The course progresses from concepts of physiologic birth and its variations through management of intrapartum, immediate postpartum, and newborn care, including the integration of the parent/baby dyad into the family.
NURS 753.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 752.
NURS 753.subject: NURS
NURS 753.title: Nurse-Midwifery Management: Intrapartum, Immediate Postpartum Newborn Care

NURS 754.description: Integrates, applies, and reflects upon the full scope clinical midwifery experience incorporating the midwifery management process, theory, evidence which emphasizes the refinement of skills, decision making, and self-evaluation in providing holistic care to the lifespan of the woman and the newborn.
NURS 754.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 753.
NURS 754.subject: NURS
NURS 754.title: Nurse-Midwifery Management: Integration Practicum

NURS 755.description: Focuses on the role of the certified nurse midwife. Special consideration is given to business, policy, legal, cultural, and ethical issues regarding nurse midwifery.
NURS 755.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 753.
NURS 755.subject: NURS
NURS 755.title: Professional Roles of the Certified Nurse Midwife

NURS 756.description: Emphasis on children’s growth development, well care, assessment and management strategies for problems commonly encountered in primary care are introduced.
NURS 756.subject: NURS
NURS 756.title: Advanced Primary Care of Children for the FNP

NURS 757.description: Emphasis on womens health, including well pregnancy, and assessment and management strategies for problems commonly encountered in primary care are introduced.
NURS 757.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 704.
NURS 757.subject: NURS
NURS 757.title: Primary Care of Women for Advanced Nursing

NURS 758.description: Management of acute health problems in the primary care setting for the FNP. Includes didactic and clinical practicum.
NURS 758.subject: NURS
NURS 758.title: Acute Problems in Primary Care for the FNP

NURS 759.description: Advanced Practice Nursing of Pediatric, Adult, and Gerontological Patients with chronic illnesses and disabilities across the lifespan for the FNP. Includes didactic and clinical practicum.
NURS 759.subject: NURS
NURS 759.title: Management of Common Chronic Health Problems for the FNP

NURS 760.description: Focuses on the role of the nurse practitioner. Special consideration is given to business, policy, legal, cultural, and ethical issues regarding primary care and FNP practice.
NURS 760.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 759.
NURS 760.subject: NURS
NURS 760.title: Family Nurse Practitioner Legal, Ethical, and Role Transition

NURS 760A.description: Supervised field study in advanced practice nursing for primary care patients (pediatric, adult, and gerontological) across the delivery continuum.
NURS 760A.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in NURS 759.
NURS 760A.subject: NURS
NURS 760A.title: Family Nurse Practitioner Role Practicum

NURS 761.description: Links neurology to behavior, psychopathology and psychopharmacology in order to prepare the advanced practice psychiatric nurse to make evidence supported treatment decisions.
NURS 761.subject: NURS
NURS 761.title: Neuroscientific Basis for Pharmacological Nonpharmacological Treatments for Psychiatric Conditions

NURS 762.description: Women’s health care focused on the reproductive, gynecological, and primary health care needs. Field study required.
NURS 762.subject: NURS
